name: Candice Warby
statement:
As a mural artist I am motivated by the power of color to completely transform a space.  I love to work with a variety of clients in different places with the goal of bringing life to a space.  Whether through branding, abstract shapes, nature inspired images or positive messaging, I am honored to capture people’s attention and brighten their day with paint. Life can be incredibly complex and challenging, and if I can bring a smile to someone’s face with a beautiful design on a wall, then I have made the world a little bit of a better place.

I believe strongly that Art is for all.  That is one of the best parts about painting murals - especially public murals.  Everyone gets to enjoy them.  And they can speak to everyone in a different way that is meaningful to them.   I love creating art that is positive, but also starts conversations and celebrates the amazing humans that inhabit this earth.  I believe that murals can also be a part of the process of bringing change and transformation as we constantly strive to improve as a species.
Art has the power to uplift and unite us. With a paintbrush in my hand, I strive to increase the joy in the world, reminding us all of the hope we can have in our shared humanity and the strength we have as we work together.
